newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bad weather slows Frankfurt airport passenger growth.
newsitem.headline: Bad weather slows Frankfurt airport passenger growth.

text.p: Bad weather limited the growth in passenger numbers at Frankfurt airport (FRA) passenger numbers which still rose 2.8 percent to 2,742,371 in January, the airport authority figures showed.
Growth would have been 0.5 percent higher if more than 500 flights had not been cancelled due to bad weather, Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
Travel to foreign destinations increased 4.5 percent to 2.18 million passengers last month, the monthly airport traffic report said.
But domestic air travel declined 3.9 percent to 503,000 passengers since more passengers were flying direct to other European airports instead of using Frankfurt as a hub, it added.
The average seat load factor of flights departing Frankfurt rose slightly to 59.2 percent with an average of 90 passengers per aircraft movement.
